# Ayu synthetic scorecard

**Generated 2026-11-01. These are SYNTHETIC calls, not real people.** Speech came from two Timbre voices, and the noise was generated by script. Real panicked callers will perform worse, so treat this as a pipeline check, not as proof of field accuracy.

Pipeline: Timbre speech, generated noise, Prisma prisma-v3.0 (codemix), Gemini gemini-3.5-flash-lite, then Ayu's triage rules. Whole calls, including every answer, went through noise and the live Prisma stream the app uses, at real-time pace with the app's own settings. Phone quality was simulated by reducing audio to 8 kHz. A microphone and a real room were not involved. The landmark list given to Prisma held only one of these five places, Gomti Nagar.
